discriminating_terms: the meeting will finish earlier than planned
attributions.rationale: The phrase “the meeting will finish earlier than planned” is a tentative prediction about an event, so it is sense:003. Unlike sense:001, it does not cast a person as having committed wrongdoing; unlike sense:002, it does not express mistrust of a person, organization, or information source.

The phrase “cast suspicion on the clerk” makes the clerk a possible wrongdoer, which is sense:001. Sense:002 would express general mistrust of the clerk or the clerk’s reliability without treating the clerk as a suspect.

discriminating_terms: appeared at the corner of her mouth
attributions.rationale: The phrase “A suspicion of a smile” that “appeared at the corner of her mouth” denotes a barely perceptible trace of an expression, sense:004. It is not sense:003, a tentative belief that someone smiled, because the sentence presents a visible trace rather than a proposition being considered.

The phrase “greeted with some suspicion” describes a wary, mistrustful attitude, sense:002. It does not state a particular tentative proposition as in sense:003, and it does not accuse a person of wrongdoing as in sense:001.

discriminating_terms: that the treasurer had committed fraud
attributions.rationale: The phrase “that the treasurer had committed fraud” identifies a particular person as having committed wrongdoing, so the suspicion is a person-directed allegation in sense:001. Although it is a that-clause, this differs from sense:003: the proposition specifically treats the treasurer as the alleged offender.

discriminating_terms: the delay was caused by a technical problem
attributions.rationale: The phrase “the delay was caused by a technical problem” is the proposition the speaker tentatively believes, which is sense:003. It does not allege that a person committed an offense as in sense:001, nor does the sentence express distrust of an information source as in sense:002.

The phrase “arrested on suspicion of fraud” identifies the people as suspected of committing an offense, sense:001. This is a criminal allegation, unlike sense:003’s tentative belief about a proposition that does not cast a person as a wrongdoer.

The phrase “a suspicion of citrus” that “made it taste fresher” describes a slight trace of flavor, sense:004. It is not sense:003, because citrus is presented as a small sensory quality rather than as a proposition whose truth is uncertain.

The phrase “came under suspicion” places the employee in the role of a possible perpetrator, sense:001. Sense:002 would be general mistrust of the employee’s reliability; this construction instead marks the person as suspected of wrongdoing.

discriminating_terms: confirmed her suspicion that the battery was failing
attributions.rationale: The phrase “confirmed her suspicion that the battery was failing” concerns a tentative proposition about the battery’s condition, sense:003. It does not accuse a person of wrongdoing as in sense:001, or express generalized mistrust as in sense:002.

discriminating_terms: a suspicion of disappointment in his voice
attributions.rationale: The phrase “a suspicion of disappointment in his voice” means a faint trace of an emotion apparent in the voice, sense:004. It differs from sense:003: the wording presents a slight perceptible quality, not a tentative belief about whether a proposition is true.

The phrase “remained under suspicion” gives the contractor continuing status as a possible wrongdoer, sense:001. Sense:002 would only convey general mistrust of the contractor’s trustworthiness; this construction means the person remains suspected of wrongdoing.

discriminating_terms: a guard had stolen the missing laptops
attributions.rationale: The phrase “a guard had stolen the missing laptops” identifies a particular person as the perpetrator of wrongdoing, so the manager’s suspicions are sense:001. This is more specific than sense:003’s uncertain proposition: the guard is directly suspected of committing the theft.

The phrase “reliability of the company's explanation” makes trustworthiness of information the object of doubt, sense:002. Unlike sense:001, it does not accuse a person of committing an offense; it expresses mistrust of the explanation’s credibility.

The phrase “everyone already knew the answer” is the proposition behind a tentative hunch, sense:003. It does not express mistrust of the answer’s reliability as in sense:002, and it does not allege wrongdoing by a particular person as in sense:001.

discriminating_terms: viewed the sudden policy change with suspicion
attributions.rationale: The phrase “viewed the sudden policy change with suspicion” describes a wary, distrustful attitude, sense:002. It does not supply a specific proposition as a tentative belief in sense:003, or cast a person as a wrongdoer in sense:001.

discriminating_terms: white with a suspicion of blue
attributions.rationale: The phrase “white with a suspicion of blue” describes a barely perceptible color tint, sense:004. It is not sense:003 because the blue is presented as a faint sensory quality rather than a doubtful proposition.

anchor.exact_quote: 例: Among the auditors, the unexplained transfer of client funds aroused suspicion that the treasurer had committed fraud.
例: Two people were arrested on suspicion of fraud after the investigation.
例: The contractor remained under suspicion until the records were checked.
例: The employee came under suspicion when several invoices disappeared.
例: The altered timestamp cast suspicion on the clerk who had access to the report.
例: The security footage confirmed the manager's suspicions that a guard had stolen the missing laptops.
例: Residents viewed the sudden policy change with suspicion.
例: The new monitoring system was initially greeted with some suspicion.
例: The discrepancy cast suspicion on the reliability of the company's explanation.

sense_usage_notes.text: on suspicion of theft は「窃盗の疑いを理由に」という定型表現である。under suspicion は、Oxford の説明では不正をしたのではないかと疑われている状態を表す。that節の形だけでなく意味上の焦点を見る。話者が節全体の真偽を暫定的に推測する用法は語義3、人に不正行為の容疑を向ける用法は語義1に置く。accusation や allegation は類義語ではなく、誰かが不正をしたという主張・告発を指す関連語である。

with suspicion は「疑いの目で、信用せずに」という態度を表す。Oxford と American Heritage はこの語義を distrust / lack of confidence と説明する。Merriam-Webster は suspicion が真実性・現実性・公正さ・信頼性への信頼の薄さを強調すると説明し、mistrust は疑いに基づく信頼の欠如を強調するとしている。

この語義では内容は悪いことに限らず、I have a suspicion that she may surprise us with good news. のように中立・肯定的な内容についても「そうではないかという気」を表せる。that節の内容が犯罪・不正かどうかだけで語義を分けない。節全体を真偽未確定の命題として推し量る用法は語義3、特定の人に犯罪・不正の容疑を向ける用法は語義1として説明する。suspicion that ... の that は内容を導く接続詞で、suspicion of ... の of は名詞句を取る。a sneaking suspicion の sneaking はここでは「盗み歩く」という直訳ではなく、表立って確信してはいないが心の中にある感覚を表す。
この a suspicion of ... は「～を疑うこと」ではなく、「～がほんの少し存在すること」である。
